title: Fake military UFO letter used to test Bill Moore

tellings.quote: basically he got a letter that was sent to AppPro and Appro looked at it and said, "Well, why don't you check this out?"

plain: Around 1979, the UFO researcher Bill Moore was tested with a fake military letter about UFOs, sent first to APRO, a civilian group that studied UFO reports, which passed it to him and told him to check it out. The writer Greg Bishop tells this, relaying what Moore himself said. It is told as the start of Moore being drawn into games played by people inside the military.
